name: 热点行更新(秒杀场景)诊断
description: 秒杀/抢购等场景下，大量并发事务对同一行执行 SELECT FOR UPDATE 或 UPDATE，导致严重的行锁争用。表现为大量事务排队等待行锁，TPS 急剧下降，响应时间飙升。核心思路是避免在数据库层串行化：拆行分桶、乐观锁、异步化、排队限流。

signals.desc: 行锁等待次数持续飙升
平均行锁等待时间显著增加
活跃线程数远超正常水平，大量线程卡在锁等待

conditions.desc: 行锁等待速率 > 50 次/秒

skip_when.desc: 非秒杀/高并发场景，偶发行锁等待属于正常现象
锁等待主要来自 DDL 操作而非 DML 热点行

root_causes.name: 单行高并发 SELECT FOR UPDATE
root_causes.desc: 秒杀场景下所有请求集中到同一行（如库存行），SELECT FOR UPDATE 获取排他锁后其他事务全部排队。并发 1000 时相当于串行执行 1000 个事务，TPS 等于单事务耗时的倒数。

root_causes.name: 事务持锁时间过长
root_causes.desc: 获取行锁后在事务内执行了远程调用、复杂计算或多次 IO，导致持锁时间从毫秒级膨胀到秒级。后续所有等待者的排队时间成倍增加。

root_causes.name: 缺少应用层限流/排队
root_causes.desc: 未在应用层做请求排队或限流，全部并发请求直接打到数据库，超出数据库行锁的承受能力。数据库不是做排队的合适组件。

root_causes.name: 热点行未做分桶拆分
root_causes.desc: 单条库存记录承受所有并发。如果将库存拆分到 N 个分桶行，争用降为 1/N，但增加了扣减和汇总的复杂度。

step1_row_lock_overview.desc: 查看当前行锁等待总体情况
step1_row_lock_overview.sql: SELECT VARIABLE_NAME, VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME IN ('Innodb_row_lock_waits', 'Innodb_row_lock_time', 'Innodb_row_lock_time_avg', 'Innodb_row_lock_time_max', 'Innodb_row_lock_current_waits')

step2_current_lock_waits.desc: 查看当前正在等待行锁的事务（谁在等谁）
step2_current_lock_waits.sql: SELECT r.trx_id AS waiting_trx, r.trx_mysql_thread_id AS waiting_thread, r.trx_query AS waiting_query, r.trx_rows_locked AS waiting_rows_locked, b.trx_id AS blocking_trx, b.trx_mysql_thread_id AS blocking_thread, b.trx_query AS blocking_query, b.trx_started AS blocking_started, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, b.trx_started, NOW()) AS blocking_duration_sec FROM information_schema.INNODB_LOCK_WAITS w JOIN information_schema.INNODB_TRX r ON w.requesting_trx_id = r.trx_id JOIN information_schema.INNODB_TRX b ON w.blocking_trx_id = b.trx_id ORDER BY blocking_duration_sec DESC LIMIT 20
step2_current_lock_waits.version_note: 8.0+ 使用 performance_schema.data_lock_waits 替代 INNODB_LOCK_WAITS

step2_current_lock_waits_80.desc: 8.0+ 查看当前行锁等待（使用 performance_schema）
step2_current_lock_waits_80.sql: SELECT r.trx_id AS waiting_trx, r.trx_mysql_thread_id AS waiting_thread, LEFT(r.trx_query, 200) AS waiting_query, b.trx_id AS blocking_trx, b.trx_mysql_thread_id AS blocking_thread, LEFT(b.trx_query, 200) AS blocking_query, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, b.trx_started, NOW()) AS blocking_sec FROM performance_schema.data_lock_waits w JOIN information_schema.INNODB_TRX r ON w.REQUESTING_ENGINE_TRANSACTION_ID = r.trx_id JOIN information_schema.INNODB_TRX b ON w.BLOCKING_ENGINE_TRANSACTION_ID = b.trx_id ORDER BY blocking_sec DESC LIMIT 20

step3_hotspot_table_detection.desc: 通过 data_locks 找出被锁定最多的表和行
step3_hotspot_table_detection.sql: SELECT OBJECT_SCHEMA, OBJECT_NAME, INDEX_NAME, LOCK_TYPE, LOCK_MODE, COUNT(*) AS lock_count FROM performance_schema.data_locks GROUP BY OBJECT_SCHEMA, OBJECT_NAME, INDEX_NAME, LOCK_TYPE, LOCK_MODE ORDER BY lock_count DESC LIMIT 20

step4_long_running_trx.desc: 找出持锁时间最长的事务
step4_long_running_trx.sql: SELECT trx_id, trx_mysql_thread_id, trx_state, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, trx_started, NOW()) AS duration_sec, trx_rows_locked, trx_rows_modified, LEFT(trx_query, 200) AS current_query FROM information_schema.INNODB_TRX WHERE trx_state = 'RUNNING' AND trx_rows_locked > 0 ORDER BY duration_sec DESC LIMIT 10

step5_contention_threads.desc: 查看当前活跃线程状态分布，确认锁等待占比
step5_contention_threads.sql: SELECT STATE, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM information_schema.PROCESSLIST WHERE COMMAND != 'Sleep' GROUP BY STATE ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT b.trx_id, b.trx_mysql_thread_id, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, b.trx_started, NOW()) AS sec, LEFT(b.trx_query, 200) FROM performance_schema.data_lock_waits w JOIN information_schema.INNODB_TRX b ON w.BLOCKING_ENGINE_TRANSACTION_ID = b.trx_id GROUP BY b.trx_id ORDER BY sec DESC LIMIT 5

steps.action: 缩短锁等待超时避免线程堆积

version_specific_notes.5.7: 使用 information_schema.INNODB_LOCK_WAITS 和 INNODB_LOCKS 查看锁等待。innodb_lock_wait_timeout 默认 50 秒。不支持 NOWAIT/SKIP LOCKED 语法
version_specific_notes.8.0: 锁信息迁移到 performance_schema.data_locks 和 data_lock_waits。新增 SELECT ... FOR UPDATE NOWAIT（立即报错）和 SKIP LOCKED（跳过已锁行）语法，非常适合秒杀场景。innodb_deadlock_detect 可关闭以减少检测开销
version_specific_notes.8.4: data_locks 性能改进。SKIP LOCKED 在高并发场景下性能进一步优化

real_world_examples.scenario: 电商秒杀活动 5000 并发扣库存，数据库 TPS 跌到 3
real_world_examples.symptoms: 秒杀开始后 Innodb_row_lock_current_waits 飙到 4800，Threads_running 到 5000，响应时间 > 30s
real_world_examples.root_cause: 所有请求对同一条库存记录执行 SELECT FOR UPDATE + UPDATE，完全串行化
real_world_examples.resolution: 改为 Redis 原子扣减预判 + 数据库异步落库。库存行拆 10 个分桶。数据库 TPS 恢复到 2000+
real_world_examples.result: 秒杀成功率从 0.1% 提升到正常水平，数据库 CPU 从 100% 降到 30%

real_world_examples.scenario: 支付系统账户余额扣减，高峰期大量超时
real_world_examples.symptoms: Innodb_row_lock_time_avg 达到 3000ms，用户支付超时率 40%
real_world_examples.root_cause: 扣减事务内调用了风控 API（200ms）和记账服务（100ms），持锁时间 > 300ms
real_world_examples.resolution: 将风控和记账移出事务，事务仅做 UPDATE balance SET amount = amount - ? WHERE amount >= ?
real_world_examples.result: 事务持锁时间从 300ms 降到 2ms，超时率降到 0.1%
